setup.purpose: Create a preserved host, isolated, or cloud onboarding baseline

dev.purpose: Own and launch the declared local service graph
dev.consumer: daily development, PM2 workbench, and onboarding

dev:health.purpose: Check prerequisites for a selected development mode

dev:smoke.purpose: Verify running services for a selected development mode

dev:clean.purpose: Inspect and remove disposable local artifacts

env:sync.purpose: Resolve the shared team environment through the existing credential path

env:check.purpose: Validate root environment capabilities without exposing values

check.purpose: Select, explain, and execute stable validation checks
check.consumer: agents, contributors, CI preparation, and package guides

test.purpose: Run the ordered uncached or Turbo-cached repository test scope
test.consumer: full local validation and CI iteration

build.consumer: CI, release preparation, and full local validation

lint.purpose: Run the repository's aggregate static analysis

format.purpose: Apply or check repository formatting through one interface

contracts.purpose: Dispatch guarded contract operations from package-owned definitions
contracts.consumer: contract operators, release tooling, and contract runbooks

browser.purpose: Select browser E2E, route, and Lighthouse proof
browser.consumer: QA, CI, and authenticated browser verification

qa.purpose: Build, pull, inspect, and report QA sessions
qa.consumer: QA session skills and team QA runbooks
